compiled_state.title: UPDATE: Add git push step to Sprint Phase 3 before sub-agent dispatch
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Update sprint/SKILL.md Phase 3 Step 3 to push the session branch to origin before dispatching sub-agents. Add a structural test asserting this push step appears in SKILL.md.

## Acceptance Criteria

**plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md — Phase 3 Step 3:**
- Before the sub-agent dispatch loop, add:
  branch 'worktree-20260511-110342' set up to track 'origin/worktree-20260511-110342'.
- This must appear BEFORE the Agent tool call / batch dispatch
- The push is required when IS_SESSION_WORKTREE=true (orchestrator running in a session worktree)
- If IS_SESSION_WORKTREE is false (orchestrator on main), skip the push (already on main)

**Structural test (new or in existing test file):**
- Create or extend a test in tests/hooks/ that:
  - Reads plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md content
  - Asserts "git push -u origin HEAD" appears before the sub-agent dispatch section
  - Test file is executable

## File Impact

### Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Phase 3, Step 3 — pre-dispatch push)

### Files to Create
- tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-push-before-dispatch.sh (new structural test)

## Done Definitions

- [ ] sprint/SKILL.md Phase 3 Step 3 contains git push -u origin HEAD before sub-agent dispatch
- [ ] Push is conditional on IS_SESSION_WORKTREE=true (or unconditional with a comment explaining it is safe)
- [ ] New structural test exists at tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-push-before-dispatch.sh
- [ ] New structural test is executable
- [ ] New structural test asserts push step appears before dispatch in SKILL.md
- [ ] New structural test passes GREEN

## Retry Budget

Max 2 retry attempts. If SKILL.md edit breaks other structural tests: read existing test assertions before editing.
